SELECT COURSE_ID as courseId, TITLE as title, DESCRIPTION as description, REGION_ID as regionId, USER_ID as userId, CREATED_AT as createdAt FROM TRAVEL_COURSE
AND (TITLE LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR DESCRIPTION LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')
ORDER BY
COURSE_ID ASC COURSE_ID DESC
SELECT COURSE_ID as courseId, TITLE as title, DESCRIPTION as description, REGION_ID as regionId, USER_ID as userId, CREATED_AT as createdAt FROM TRAVEL_COURSE WHERE COURSE_ID = #{id}
SELECT COURSE_ID, TITLE, DESCRIPTION, REGION_ID, USER_ID, CREATED_AT FROM TRAVEL_COURSE WHERE TITLE LIKE '%' || #{tag} || '%' OR DESCRIPTION LIKE '%' || #{tag} || '%' ORDER BY COURSE_ID DESC
